ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: Given: As shown in the figure, the line $BO \perp AO$ at point $O$, $OB$ bisects $\angle COD$, $\angle AOC=68^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle DOA$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AO \perp BO$,\\
it follows that $\angle AOB = 90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle AOC = 68^\circ$,\\
it follows that $\angle BOC = 90^\circ - 68^\circ = 22^\circ$,\\
Since $OB$ bisects $\angle COD$,\\
it follows that $\angle COD = 2\angle BOC = 44^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle DOA = \angle DOC + \angle AOC = 44^\circ + 68^\circ = \boxed{112^\circ}$, therefore C meets the requirements of the problem.
